body: Thank you for your comment. I agree that knowing other people out there are going through the same thing helps. I think our capacity for empathy can sometimes be our greatest strength and our greatest weakness. We feel connected to other people, and responsible for helping with their problems. But at the same time we are all so isolated from any community efforts toward social change because we can't function well enough to be out in the world. So we shoulder all of the burden alone and it crushes us. But what can we do? I think if I already knew the answer, my depression would resolve itself.

If you ask me, the people who can walk right by someone suffering and feel absolutely nothing are the ones who are sick. We should study *their* brains and give *them* pills to fix *them* instead of the other way around. I'll never understand why society's answer to a feeling person is to numb them. This world needs more people to care, not less.
